    allow_skip: true
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## libraries
library(learnr)
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

options(warn = 1)

Sys.setenv(LEARNR_USE_DB = "true")
use_database <- tolower(Sys.getenv("LEARNR_USE_DB", "false")) %in% c("1", "true", "yes", "on")

conn <- NULL
if (use_database) {
  db_host <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DB_HOST")
  db_port <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DB_PORT")
  db_name <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DB_NAME")
  db_user <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DB_USER")
  db_pass <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DB_PASSWORD")

  if (all(nzchar(c(db_host, db_port, db_name, db_user, db_pass)))) {
    conn <- try(
      DBI::dbConnect(
        RPostgres::Postgres(),
        host = db_host,
        port = as.integer(db_port),
        dbname = db_name,
        user = db_user,
        password = db_pass
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    use_database <- FALSE
  }
}

rsconnect::writeManifest()
```


```{r}
if (!use_database) {
  cat("❌ Database disabled or environment variables missing.")
} else if (inherits(conn, "try-error")) {
  cat("❌ Database connection failed.")
} else {
  cat("✅ Database connected successfully.")
}

```


```{r}
if (use_database && !inherits(conn, "try-error")) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT 1 AS test_value;")
} else {
  NULL
}

```


```{r}
## ---- db-read-write-test ----
if (use_database && !inherits(conn, "try-error")) {

  # 1. Write test (INSERT)
  DBI::dbExecute(
    conn,
    "
    INSERT INTO statistics2_module1
      (user_id, event, label, correct, question, answer)
    VALUES
      ('_test_user_', 'test_event', 'test_label', 'TRUE', 'test_question', 'test_answer');
    "
  )

  # 2. Read test (SELECT)
  result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    conn,
    "
    SELECT *
    FROM statistics2_module1
    WHERE user_id = '_test_user_';
    "
  )

  print(result)


} else {
  cat("❌ Database not available — read/write test skipped.")
}

```
